title: sitePerfectOverMap additive
statement:
For every ring sheaf R and arrow f:V→U of its site, further module restriction from C/U to C/V is additive.

Precise quantified statement:
instance sitePerfectOverMap_additive
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}) {U V : C} (f : V ⟶ U) : (overMap.{max u v r} R f).Additive

Notions used: [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

proof.text: Further restriction acts on each component of a module morphism. Evaluate both sides on an object and a section; the equality is reflexivity.
